notes.text: Teams can keep their own Google Drive folder with their own goal horn, intro, game music, tabs and songs. Everything else comes from the shared library.
The team button at the top lists only your teams. Change which teams show in Settings › Teams on this device.
Edit is for the organizer and each team's music volunteer, so every phone on a team plays the same thing. Everyone else gets changes with Check for updates.
Team music volunteers: Publish your team sends your changes to everyone on your team, and you can hide shared tabs your team doesn't use.
Organizers: Settings › Admin shows every team, its Drive folder, its music volunteers and who the shared library is shared with.
Simpler Settings: Add music folder, Add music files, Open Drive download and Show name are gone. Music comes from Check for updates, and new songs are added with Edit › Add songs.
Start over › Reset to the Drive layout puts back the team's layout if you made a mess with Edit. Your music stays.
Clean up storage can now remove all the music from a device (this replaces Remove stored music).
Organizers: layout files, show packs and the Drive connection moved to Settings › Advanced (organizer), which volunteers don't see.
Organizers: if someone else published since your last update, Publish to Drive warns you first and offers Get latest first.
Help has a section for organizers, and the volunteer questions are simpler.
New installs now start with all three teams (Barracudas, Bulldogs and Eagles) and the latest buttons, even before the music is downloaded.
Release notes: see what's in an update before you tap Update now, and what changed right after updating. They're also in Help › What's new.
The goal horn and whistle songs are kept ready, so the first tap of the night starts right away.
Simpler Settings: show packs, Restore the built-in show and Start an empty show are now under Advanced.
The top of Settings is now called Get Most Recent Updates.
Security improvements.
Clean up storage (Settings › Music on this device) removes extra copies of songs. It shows exactly what would be removed first.
Adding songs that are already on the device asks whether to replace or keep them, instead of saving a second copy.
The app opens straight away, even on weak rink wifi or with no internet.
A message when a new version is ready, with Update now or Later.
A rink wifi sign-in page can no longer break the app's offline copy.
Security improvements.
Team dropdown at the top: pick from any number of teams.
The progress bar now sits right under Check for updates.
Buttons no longer hide behind the iPhone camera cut-out.
New gear icon for Settings.
The version number is shown at the top of Help.
Everyone can use Edit again. Changes stay on your own device.
A warning before a Drive update replaces changes you made on your device.
Download all music and Check for updates straight from the team's Google Drive folder, after signing in with Google.
Organizer: Publish to Drive sends layout changes and new songs to everyone.
